segments.text: Now, some details of the costs and timings.
An adult ticket costs £18, children under 16 £8 and student tickets are £13, but you
must bring your student card.
A family ticket costs £36 and it includes two adults and up to two children.
All tickets can be used up to 10 times within 48 hours.
This means you can get on and off the bus up to a maximum of 10 times within 2 days.
So you could, for instance, start the tour in the afternoon and finish the tour the
day after, as long as you schedule it in 10 rides.
You can purchase tickets at any of the 5 stops.
You can also book tickets online on our website or over this phone line.
Just wait until the end of this message and follow the next steps.
When booking online, you need to print your e-ticket.
Do not show it on your device because the driver cannot stamp it.
When booking over the phone, you can collect your tickets at any of the stops by simply
giving the staff your reference number.
Buses start running from 9am and the last one leaves the station at 5pm.
There is a 30 minute interval between each bus and it takes about 60 minutes for a bus
to finish its route.
There are many attractions at each of the stops, so there will be plenty to do wherever
you get off the bus.
The bus tickets do not include entrance fees to any of these attractions, except for the
museum near the harbour side.
If you purchase 10 or more tickets in advance, you can book a local guide who can show
you around and give you all the information needed with no additional fee.
We also have audio commentary that has been specially recorded for the bus
tour by the tourist office. Headphones are available on the bus and are easy
to operate. There is no extra charge for these. Just plug them in, select the
required language and adjust the volume. Thank you for calling Bristol City Bus
tour. We look forward to seeing you soon on one of our tour buses.
